definitions.explanation: One particular feature or way of looking at something; a perspective.
The side surface of something; lateral part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧の{側面|そくめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To see another aspect of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な{側面|そくめん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This policy also has an economic aspect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{側面|そくめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あり、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧では⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧できない。
examples.english: Culture has various aspects and cannot be understood from just one perspective.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面|そくめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入口|いりぐち}→入口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's an entrance on the side of the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面|そくめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついた→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: There's a scratch on the side of the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側面|そくめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: There's a name written on the side of the box.

notes:
{側面|そくめん} has both a physical meaning (the side of an object) and a figurative meaning (an aspect or facet of something). The figurative use is more common in everyday language.

SENSE 1 — FIGURATIVE (aspect, facet):
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧の{側面|そくめん}: another aspect
- {側面|そくめん}から⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to view from another angle
- {側面|そくめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have an aspect
- ⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な{側面|そくめん}: economic aspect
- ⟦{心理的|しんりてき}→心理的：05686_shinriteki⟧な{側面|そくめん}: psychological aspect

SENSE 2 — PHYSICAL (side, flank):
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧の{側面|そくめん}: side of a building
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧の{側面|そくめん}: side of a car
- {側面|そくめん}⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧: side-on collision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {側面|そくめん}: side, aspect (concrete or abstract)
- ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧: face, aspect (broader, more general)
- ⟦{観点|かんてん}→観点：05582_kanten⟧: viewpoint, perspective (from which one looks)
- ⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧: phase, situation (of events or developments)
